questions.question:
In a certain code language,

A + B means 'A is the brother of B',

A - B means 'A is the father of B',

A × B means 'A is the mother of B',

A ÷ B means 'A is the wife of B'.

Based on the above, if 'P × Q - R ÷ S + T', which of the following is true?

options.text: T is the brother of R.
P is the mother of R.
T is the sister of S.
Q is the son of P.

questions.solution:
Preparing the family tree diagram by using the following symbols:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fb81ed7f70e1cad80ead53e811c6a7ff748195dcb55d6a2a1edbc634ab4e4850.png] 

As per the given information:

 
 

 
 
A is

Brother

**Given expression:** 'P × Q - R ÷ S + T'

P is the mother of Q, Q is the father of R, R is the wife of S and S is the brother of T.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f0b8a68ed01ed811a1e61c2c72789aebb3ff6d786dd668ff2cd4561104a18e92.png]

Hence, the correct answer is "Option (4)".

questions.question: Each of the letters in the word NETWORK are arranged in alphabetical order. How many letters are there in the English alphabetical series between the letter which is fourth from the left and the one which is second from the right?
questions.solution:

questions.question:
What will come in the place of '?' in the following equation, if '+' and '-' are interchanged and '×' and '÷' are interchanged?

53 ÷ 4 - 21 × 7 + 14 = ?
questions.solution:
Here, we use the BODMAS table given below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/46b604fb8902923154e673ceab8f974f0d829a8ef710d499b9c5c41b43b1e885.png] 

**Given:**

​⇒ 53 ÷ 4 - 21 × 7 + 14 = ?

After interchanging '+' and '-' and '×' and '÷' →

​⇒ 53 × 4 + __**21 ÷ 7**__ - 14

Apply BODMAS rule

​⇒ __**53 × 4**__ + 3 - 14

​⇒ 212 + 3 - 14

​⇒ 215 - 14 = **201**

**​⇒ '53 × 4 + 21 ÷ 7 - 14 = 201'**

Here, the value of the equation is** '201'.**

Hence, the correct answer is "Option (2)".

If 12 April 2004 is Monday, then what will be the day of the week on 24 May 2012?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

12 April 2004 = Monday

24 May 2012 = ?

As we know odd days in a normal year and a leap year are '1' and '2'.

Odd days up to 24 May 2012 = (1 + 1 + 1 + 2 + 1 + 1 + 1 + 2 + 18 + 24) = 52

Odd days up to 24 May 2012 = (52 ÷ 7) =3 (Tuesday, Wednesday, **Thursday**)

**24 May 2012 = Thursday**

Hence, the correct answer is "Option (3)".
